_about: Modular transport content behind /transport/. Each section lists the fact ids it shows (resolved from data/facts.json with their verification status), the official sources a traveller should check, a link to the long-form guide, and the update categories whose latest items appear in it. Change a fact once and every section that shows it changes.

sections.title: How to reach Nashik
sections.summary: Nashik can be reached by air, rail, bus and road. Rail and road from Mumbai and Pune are the usual routes; this page shows what we know, how sure we are, and which official source to check before you go.
guides: Full guide: how to reach Nashik for the Kumbh Mela

sections.title: By air
sections.summary: Nashik (Ozar) Airport is the city's airport. Whether scheduled commercial flights operate, and to where, is set by airlines and the airport operator and has not been verified here. A new terminal has been approved, and press reports describe a push to start civil operations before the Mela. Mumbai and Pune airports are the alternatives; confirm flights with the airlines.

sections.title: By train
sections.summary: Nashik Road is the main railway station. Timetables, special trains and cancellations are published by Indian Railways; book and check on the official systems.

sections.title: By bus
sections.summary: MSRTC and private operators connect Nashik with Mumbai, Pune and other cities. Fares and frequencies change; check the operator.

sections.title: By road
sections.summary: Nashik is on the national highway network. Road conditions, works and Mela traffic diversions change; check police and highway advisories on the day.

sections.title: Mumbai to Nashik
sections.summary: The most common route into Nashik, by rail or road.

sections.title: Pune to Nashik
sections.summary: Usually by road; check rail options with Indian Railways.

sections.title: Delhi to Nashik
sections.summary: A long journey; most travellers combine a flight or a long-distance train with a final leg by road or rail.

sections.title: Nashik (Ozar) Airport
sections.summary: What we know about the airport, and what is only approved or planned.

sections.title: Nashik Road Railway Station
sections.summary: The main station for the city. Works at five stations near the Mela area were announced by the Ministry of Railways.

sections.title: Nashik to Trimbakeshwar
sections.summary: Trimbakeshwar is a separate town in the hills, reached by road.
guides: Trimbakeshwar to Nashik: distance and route

sections.title: Local transport
sections.summary: Within Nashik, the usual options are autos, taxis and buses. Panchavati is best explored on foot.

sections.title: Kumbh transport
sections.summary: Railways say special trains (long-distance specials and short-distance MEMU services) are planned. No train numbers, routes or dates have been located, and no shuttle-bus or road arrangements have been announced in sources we found. The Railways, MSRTC, the police and the Authority will publish these.

sections.title: Parking
sections.summary: No official Kumbh parking plan has been located. Parking and traffic arrangements are set by the police and may change daily.
